overview: A live extension needs care as browsers change. This is a fixed starter sprint: we review your extension, update outdated code and libraries, fix compatibility problems with current Chrome and Edge, and ship the first improvements from your wish list. You get a tested update package and a short health note. Ongoing monthly care is quoted separately if you want us to keep going.

faq: No. This is a fixed one-time sprint with a clear scope. If you want continuing care, we quote a monthly plan separately once we have seen how much your extension needs.
What if a browser update breaks my extension later?
That falls outside this sprint. You can order another sprint, or ask us for a monthly plan where compatibility checks are part of the work.
Do you need my store account?
Not to do the work. We need the source code. If you want us to upload the update, add us as a collaborator on your developer account instead of sharing a password.
Can you fix a store policy warning?
Often, yes. Send the notice from the store and we change the code, permissions or listing text to meet the rule. We follow the platform rules and never hide features from reviewers.
